source: GitHub Actions job log for job 112075201808, the ONLY surviving record. The tapes were committed to a detached HEAD on the runner, never pushed, and destroyed when the runner was torn down.
why_not_counted: No tape survives, so no market can be put through the measurement-validity gates, no per-market book/order/fill detail exists, and uncertain fills cannot be separated per market. A log summary is not evidence of a cohort market. The 25-market cohort therefore stands at 0.

what_the_log_establishes.discovery_worked: every segment discovered live, soonest-ending up-down markets; the date-floored ascending paging fix was correct
what_the_log_establishes.valid_books_obtained: yes -- a COMPLETE status requires >= 30 successful two-sided book reads AND reaching the window end, and 12 markets reached COMPLETE
what_the_log_establishes.hypothetical_orders_instantiated: yes -- evidenced fills are only reachable through the owned-order lifecycle

attributable_to_run_3_alone.basis: the two quarantined tapes from runs 1-2 contributed 27 INCOMPLETE + 114 NO_ELIGIBLE_MARKET and exactly 0 COMPLETE and 0 fills, so the COMPLETE and fill totals are run 3's alone

failure_mechanism: A local commit of mine rewrote analysis/l5/shadow/COHORT_PROGRESS.json at 02:31Z. CI committed its own version of the same file, then `git pull --rebase` hit a content conflict on it at 02:37:19Z and left .git/rebase-merge in place. Every push thereafter failed with 'there is already a rebase-merge directory', four fatal retries per segment, all swallowed by `|| sleep`. Collection and local commits continued normally for 56 more minutes on a detached HEAD.
my_three_errors: Putting a shared mutable file in CI's commit set, which makes a rebase conflict inevitable under any concurrent edit.
Writing to that exact file from this workstation at 02:31Z while the run was live.

Reading 'no tape on origin' as 'no data collected' and cancelling the run to read its log, which destroyed the only copy. Job logs are unreadable while a job runs, so cancelling was the only way to see them -- and it was the wrong trade.
not_an_s1_result: Nothing here is evidence about S1's fill opportunity, and the 157 evidenced fills must NOT be read as a result: they were produced under the frozen candidate but cannot be audited, gate-checked or separated from uncertain fills without the tapes. S1 is unchanged and will be re-measured from zero.
fix: CI now commits only uniquely-named run-scoped files (tapes plus analysis/l5/shadow/runs/<run_id>.json), clears any half-finished rebase before each pull, uses --autostash, and raises ::error:: when a committed segment cannot be pushed. See analysis/l5/shadow/runs/README.md.
